author: winewidly

title: Buggy and full of AI generated assets
body: I have no issues with the intention and paid nature of the app itself, but after years of coming back to it after the AI boom, everything feels extremely artificial and sloppy. The timer in the app is buggy- when I pause my tasks, the timer continues in the dynamic island and finishes my task!!, the tasks sometimes finish twice in the same day with two consecutive success screens, messing with the streaks. The images and assets are low quality AI slop images and graphics, the typography feels bland and uninteresting; it feels like fabulous has fired their entire old team and replaced them with claude and mid journey. Freemium apps are looking better these days than this paid app. It really feels heavily vibe coded with no attention to UI quality and core features. And for that, this is absolutely overpriced. I hope they start taking the design aspect of the app seriously or I’m gonna literally take my money to headspace, something I vowed to never do

title: Fraudsters!!
body: I had approved the annual subscription autopay with the understanding that the amount would be deducted only after the one-week trial period ended. However, the charges for the annual subscription were deducted during the trial period itself, and the support team refuses to respond/help. The app offers nothing of value—it’s a complete waste of time and money. Rs 5900 down the drain for nothing!

title: Fraudulent charged for a year
body:
I was shown a trial message and approved a autopay request for 5900 INR. However, on opening the app, the subscription got activated and my account has been debited for the money, for a purchase I didnot make. 
Worst part is clarify claims to give 100% refund, even post subscription. But their website tactically asks you to go through the Apple refund support, who in turn deny the refund request.
